# Code of Conduct

Open Spark Jev is part of Nokast, an open-source AI community. We want it to be a respectful, harassment-free space for everyone who contributes, regardless of background or experience.

**Expected:** be kind and constructive, assume good faith, give credit, disagree with ideas rather than people, and report safety failures openly and without blame.

**Not acceptable:** harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, publishing others' private information, or pasting credentials or private data into issues.

Maintainers may remove comments, close issues or ban contributors who violate this. Report concerns privately to the maintainers (see the repository owner's profile) or through GitHub's reporting tools. This text adopts the spirit of the Contributor Covenant 2.1.
